purpose: Probe whether the zero-question result is specific to browser Deep Research product harnesses by testing two different web-agent/chat harnesses.
h1_trigger: Run H1 for a system only if its H0 run asks zero task-specific clarification questions.
attribution_limit: Kimi and DeepSeek web products differ in base model, system prompt, tools, UI workflow, and harness. Cross-product differences are system-level evidence, not pure model effects. H0-to-H1 within a product diagnoses sensitivity to the elicitation nudge, not spontaneous clarification intelligence.
